## Projects

### Sandrone

- [Sandrone](https://docs.doughmination.gay/projects/sandrone.md): Sandrone is an all-in-one Discord bot.
- [Commands](https://docs.doughmination.gay/projects/sandrone/commands.md): Everything Sandrone answers to. All of them are slash commands, so Discord will fill in the options for you as you type.
- [Terms of Service](https://docs.doughmination.gay/projects/sandrone/tos.md): Effective 31 August 2026
- [Privacy Policy](https://docs.doughmination.gay/projects/sandrone/privacy.md): Effective 31 August 2026
- [Doughmination Music](https://docs.doughmination.gay/projects/doughmination-music.md): Doughmination Music is a free public player.
